source.author: verg
source.text: Iam summas arces Tritonia, respice, Pallas insedit, nimbo effulgens et Gorgone saeva.
source.text_original: Iam summas arces Tritonia, respice, Pallas / insedit, nimbo effulgens et Gorgone saeva.
source.text_english: Now Pallas of Triton, look, has taken her seat on the highest citadels, shining with a cloud and with the fierce Gorgon.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: in moenia pernix Thespia et ad carum Tritonia devolat Argum.
reuse.text_original: in moenia pernix / Thespia et ad carum Tritonia devolat Argum.
reuse.text_english: Swift Thespia flies down to the walls, and Tritonia to dear Argus.
